# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""reconcile_github_tree.py — 发布树全量对账：本地所有件 vs GitHub 远端 tree（逐 blob sha）。

判据：两端 sha 集合完全一致（本地多/少/异 → 逐一列出）。用于"另一端下载复验"前的自检。
"""
import json
import os
import pathlib
import subprocess

REPO = "master666-max/cbb-pipeline"
PKG = pathlib.Path(r"D:/zcode专用！！！！危险！！！！！！！！！/正典库构建系统/cbb-pipeline-skill/cbb-pipeline")


def gh(args):
    r = subprocess.run(["gh", "api"] + args, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8")
    if r.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(r.stderr[:300])
    return json.loads(r.stdout)


ref = gh([f"repos/{REPO}/git/refs/heads/main"])
commit = ref["object"]["sha"]
tree = gh([f"repos/{REPO}/git/trees/{commit}?recursive=1"])
remote = {e["path"]: e["sha"] for e in tree["tree"] if e["type"] == "blob"}

local = {}
for p in sorted(PKG.rglob("*")):
    if p.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in p.parts:
        rel = p.relative_to(PKG).as_posix()
        h = subprocess.run(["git", "hash-object", str(p)], capture_output=True, text=True,
                           encoding="utf-8").stdout.strip()
        local[rel] = h

only_local = sorted(set(local) - set(remote))
only_remote = sorted(set(remote) - set(local))
diff = sorted(k for k in set(local) & set(remote) if local[k] != remote[k])

print(f"远端 HEAD {commit[:7]} | 本地 {len(local)} 件 / 远端 {len(remote)} 件")
print(f"仅本地（未推）: {len(only_local)}")
for k in only_local:
    print("   +", k)
print(f"仅远端（本地缺）: {len(only_remote)}")
for k in only_remote:
    print("   -", k)
print(f"内容不一致: {len(diff)}")
for k in diff:
    print("   ~", k)
print("✓ 两端一致（逐 blob sha）" if not (only_local or only_remote or diff) else "✗ 存在差异（见上）")
